entries.body: Stage 1 rules (verbatim essentials): export_records(records,user,params)->str. records: dicts id(int unique),title,owner,project,status(active|archived),amount(decimal str keep exact),confidential(bool),created(YYYY-MM-DD); do not modify input. user: name,role,projects. params may be empty; ignore unmentioned keys. Base: all records, ascending id. [Format] CSV via csv.writer default dialect, lineterminator='\n', header id,title,owner,amount; id as int, amount as given; no records -> header only. [Permissions] role viewer -> PermissionError; admin any project; other roles only records with project in user[projects], others silently dropped. [Confidential] confidential True never exported, except role admin and params.get(purpose)==audit (other rules still apply).
